instructions: Answer questions about very large data with {"action":"rlm","task":"..."} plus optional "prompt_file":"big.txt" (workspace-relative) or inline "prompt". A sub-model works in a persistent Python REPL: the data stays in REPL variables, never in a context window. The REPL exposes `plugins`, a mapping of ALL currently installed plugin libraries keyed by plugin id (e.g. plugins["process"]), so the sub-model can query live data itself. Prefer this over read for huge files. Budget overrides are ACTION FIELDS, not prose: pass e.g. {"action":"rlm","task":"...","max_iterations":10} - a limit stated only inside the task text does not bind the run (also overridable: max_llm_calls, max_depth, exec_timeout_seconds, total_timeout_seconds). The result is {ok, answer, iterations, llm_calls, stopped}; each execution round is audit-logged to rlm_trace.jsonl in the workspace unless the operator disables tracing.
